hypothesis: Use first measured-room Shadow confirmation close as a limit price inside the roll confirmation zone. Frozen 4H stop and measured extension cap; fixed first TP earns net 2R at the planned adverse fill. May add entries without deep roll recrossing or lower minimum RR.
prospective_windows: Non-overlapping seven-day UTC windows anchored at 2026-10-08; only completed UTC days. First partial daily read on 2026-10-09. Separate cohort, no additions to existing protocol samples.

rules.seed: First existing Shadow v2-qualified confirmation per setup; existing colour AND close beyond roll, plus retest and valid 4H structural stop. Failed initial room eligibility is not rearmed.
rules.entry: Limit at that confirmation close, strictly on confirmed side of roll; no signal-bar fill.
rules.target: Freeze net-2R TP at signal time from planned adverse fill and fixed structural stop. TP must stay inside frozen measured extension. Never widen stop.
rules.invalidation: Before each potential fill: same setup, valid current structural stop, latest CLOSED 15M colour AND roll confirmation and retest still valid. Expire after four bars. Opening through roll or stop rejects.
rules.fill: Later closed-bar limit touch. Favorable opening gaps allowed only inside roll zone; actual adverse assumed fill must still have net RR >=2 and stay between stop and target.
rules.signal_time: Signal close +1ms exclusion sentinel; state at bar open uses only preceding closed candles.
rules.fill_candle: Any TP/SL touch on intrabar limit-fill candle is AMBIGUOUS; no MFE/MAE from fill bar.
rules.outcomes: Consecutive later closed bars only; gaps stop evaluation, TP+SL in one bar AMBIGUOUS; stop opening gaps charge worse price.
rules.duplicates: First qualified seed per setup, no rearm, no ticker identity inference
rules.precision: Continuous hypothetical prices. Exchange price tick, queue, spread, funding and actual fills unvalidated.

portfolio.quantity: reserve at creation using net stop risk and known cash; round observed size step; no future profit increases
portfolio.uncertain: freeze capital on ambiguous result/gap; equity and ROI unknown

decision.kill: Any sufficiently sampled retrospective period net AvgR<=0 or PF<=1: KILL and do not activate forward collection.
decision.insufficient: CONTINUE_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE; retain all rules; no promotion.
decision.retrospective_pass: Both fixed periods >=20 resolved, AvgR>0, PF>1 and net additional filled setups vs current >0: FORWARD_SHADOW_REQUIRED.
decision.forward: Only complete future registered windows with >=20 resolved, positive net AvgR, PF>1, net incremental fills and cost/capital review can justify manual production consideration. No automatic promotion.
decision.roi: Report realized cash separately; OPEN/AMBIGUOUS/data gaps keep equity and full ROI unknown.

limitations: Retrospective periods already viewed; no untouched validation claim.
Extra price touches are not live fills; conservative OHLC ambiguity may censor outcomes.
Cost-adjusted net risk R differs from original Shadow price-stop R.
No condition tuning after viewing this experiment. Existing frozen strategy protocols and live signals remain unchanged.
